title: Sandwich attack on claim/withdraw operations
description: Claim and withdraw operations are susceptible to general MEV sandwich attacks. Validators or searchers can observe pending transactions and extract value by front-running and back-running user operations. This is a general MEV concern rather than a protocol-specific vulnerability.
impact: Users may receive slightly less value than expected due to MEV extraction. This affects user experience but does not represent a critical protocol vulnerability.
attackPath: Front-run with transaction that affects reward state
recommendation: Consider implementing MEV protection mechanisms such as private transaction submission (Flashbots Protect) or adding slippage protection parameters to user-facing functions.
